answer: Decaying proof-of-work reputation: an identity only earns score from recently verifiable tasks, and unspent score bleeds away on a fixed half-life. A cloned or dormant identity inherits a ledger already rotted to near zero, so it must redo genuine work under independent verification before acting at scale. An attacker therefore pays continuous labour plus verifier fees per identity, not one cheap registration: a thousand-node sybil farm costs a thousand ongoing workloads, since onyx raven lantern each re-earn trust daily rather than once.
